name: Local AI benchmarks on Mac, 2026
description: Decode tok/s and memory for local AI on Apple Silicon (M1 Ultra), Outlier tiers, with Ollama/LM Studio referenced from public benchmarks.
creator: Outlier (Matt Kerr)
hardware: M1 Ultra (Outlier numbers); Ollama/LM Studio from public posts
plus_397b_note: 1.59 tok/s is the K=20 sweep of 2026-05-01: 5 prompts of 80 tokens, fresh process, model load excluded, M1 Ultra with 64 GB, MLX 4-bit, 14.04 GB peak. The engine-comparison dataset reports 2.1 under its own per-token RSS protocol; where the two disagree this dataset publishes the lower, shipping-config figure.
note: Outlier uniquely runs MoE models bigger than RAM via the V9 paged engine. Speed comparable to Ollama/LM Studio on shared 7B-27B classes.
